import griffe

# Load package at v1.0.0 and HEAD using git-aware loading
old = griffe.load("mypkg", ref="v1.0.0")
new = griffe.load("mypkg", ref="HEAD")

# Iterate over and print all breakages
for breakage in griffe.get_broken_items(old, new):
    print(breakage)
